title: The archery challenge's last 20 seconds
description: With 20 seconds or less left in the Moon Room, the targets that come back are UFOs, worth 2 more points and faster, and the targets sway as they rise and fall. The player's arrows down a UFO every two seconds, each for 3 points, until the timer runs out at 35 points: FINISHED!, the entrance turns into a door, and he goes through it to the high scores room.
